items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Told me to go downtown and ask for Jack Goldberg... And I went down there. He told me where to go... Jack Goldberg and Mr. -- it'll come to me a little later, his name --

ctx.x: You mean when you came to New York?

Yeah. Told me to go downtown and ask for Jack Goldberg, and tell Jack Goldberg he sent me. And I went down there. He told me where to go. And I went down there and they asked me what did I want to sing. And I told them, I said, well, I've got a couple of songs I'll sing. I sing, "You've got to Reap what you Sow," and "If you Want to Keep your Daddy Home."

And they had a piano player. In the meantime, this Bill Vodery, he was -- soon as I got there, I guess I was young and he was looking at me, you know. So he --
He's the one who had the military band?
